entries.2b8f7cf947a66d37: Densan System Holdings is a holding company that conducts management of group companies and related operations; the group consists of the company, 9 consolidated subsidiaries and 2 equity-method affiliates, 12 companies in total. As a comprehensive information processing services company, it operates in two segments: the Information Services Business and the Payment Collection Agency Services Business (as of December 31, 2025).
entries.3fdd96f1fa291d8e: A holding company engaged in an information services business that carries out system development and information processing services, and a payment collection agency services business that handles payments such as convenience store payments and bank account transfers.
entries.5174606a86823fe7: As an independent IT vendor, it provides one-stop services from SI (system integration), software development and system implementation support through operation and maintenance, and also provides BPO services such as invoice issuance outsourcing, data center environment provision and information security business, and sells system equipment and software products as merchandise and products.
entries.5c20d65937381049: It provides agency services for collecting payments using credit card companies, convenience stores, banks and electronic money operators as collection points.

entries.dec37ba2fa5dc0ce: As an independent IT vendor, it provides one-stop services from SI (system integration), software development and system implementation support through operation and maintenance, and also provides BPO services such as invoice issuance outsourcing, data center environment provision and information security business, and sells system equipment and software products as merchandise and products. entries.f10f8385648c5876: It provides agency services for collecting payments using credit card companies, convenience stores, banks and electronic money operators as collection points. It provides convenience store payment collection agency, account transfer, online payments such as paperless payments and credit card payments, domestic remittance, and guaranteed deferred payment services. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥25,069 million.
